race.comment: ISHIKARI (13) third up for this and finds a winnable contest on her home track. Jumped in grade and trip with a courageous on-pace third over 1400m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Can take control early from the gate and prove too strong for these. JENNI THE JET (14) is racing well in town and shapes as a top three contender on recent efforts. Stalked the tempo with the claim to get up in a thrilling finish over 1250m at Canterbury. Looks the testing material again and proven at this distance range. TOM VEGAS (16) eye-catching return in Highway grade with the 59kg when sixth over 1100m at Randwick. Further improved now and can race much closer from the rails draw. Don't underestimate. CRUSADER KINGS (6) resumed over 1200m at Dubbo last start and scored by a nose. Must include.
